headlines.description: LeSean McCoy scored three times and the Buffalo Bills extended their winning streak to four with a 45-16 victory over San Francisco and new starter Colin Kaepernick Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy scores 3 TDs in Bills 45-16 win over 49ers

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw for 271 yards and hit Arrelious Benn for a 51-yard touchdown in the closing minutes, lifting the Jacksonville Jaguars to a 17-16 victory over the Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bortles hits Benn for 51-yard TD, Jaguars beat Bears 17-16

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Detroit Lions

headlines.shortLinkText: Prater's kick, Bush's pick give Lions 31-28 win over Rams

headlines.shortLinkText: Mariota throws 3 TDs as Titans beat winless Browns 28-26

headlines.description: The Miami Dolphins left Ben Roethlisberger limping, and the rest of the Pittsburgh Steelers didn't look much better.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins stop Big Ben and beat Steelers 30-15

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady had a smooth regular-season home debut.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady has big day in homecoming, Patriots beat Bengals 35-17

events.name: Carolina Panthers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees passed for 465 yards and four touchdowns, Will Lutz kicked a 52-yard field goal with 11 seconds left, and the New Orleans Saints pulled out a 41-38 victory over the Carolina Panthers o
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees leads Saints past slumping Panthers, 41-38

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at New York Giants

headlines.description: A banged-up Odell Beckham Jr. turned a short fourth-and-1 pass into a winning 66-yard catch and run with 1:24 to play Sunday as the New York Giants snapped a three-game losing streak with a stunn
headlines.shortLinkText: Beckham's career day, late 66-yard TD lead Giants

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for 263 yards and two touchdowns and the Washington Redskins ran roughshod over one of the NFL's top defenses in a 27-20 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins beat up Eagles' defense on way to 27-20 victory

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Spencer Ware ran for a career-high 131 yards and a touchdown and Alex Smith picked apart Oakland's struggling defense in the Kansas City Chiefs' 26-10 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ware, Smith help lead Chiefs to 26-10 over Raiders

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Rookie Dak Prescott threw for 247 yards and three touchdowns, and the Dallas Cowboys forced four turnovers in a 30-16 win over the Green Bay Packers and their dysfunctional offense on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throw for 3 scores, Cowboys beat Packers 30-16

headlines.description: Steven Hauschka's 44-yard FG with 1:57 remaining capped the 20th career fourth quarter or OT comeback for Seattle QB Russell Wilson, and the Seahawks pulled out a wild 26-24 win over Atlanta.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson leads Seattle's late rally for 26-24 win over Atlanta

headlines.description: Nick Novak made a 33-yard field goal in overtime to give the Houston Texans to a 26-23 comeback victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Osweiler rallies Texans to 26-23 OT victory over Colts

events.name: New York Jets at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: David Johnson rushed for 111 yards and three touchdowns, and the Arizona Cardinals shut down the listless New York Jets 28-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Johnson, Cardinals roll past listless Jets 28-3
